name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.TraceEmitter.load_registered
title: Exact input rearrangement on the production three-tape transducer
statement: Starting with arbitrary framed parameters, statement and witness followed by any suffix, after 2|p|+3|s|+3|w|+7 native ticks the input head is at the suffix, the decoded statement and true-prefixed witness occupy separate tapes, both work heads are back at zero and the machine is ready to execute gates.
